manual.detail: Dev/test builds optimize libsqlite3-sys, sha2, ring and serde_json at level 3. Dependency debug info remains disabled; debug assertions and overflow checks remain enabled. The first build recompiles affected units; later unchanged builds reuse them. Workspace package optimization defaults are unchanged.
